Facts:
- Fulgencio Batista was born on January 16, 1901, and was born as Rubén Zaldívar.
- Carlos Prío Socarrás was born on July 14, 1903.
- Fulgencio Batista was the elected President of Cuba from 1940 to 1944.
- Carlos Prío Socarrás was the President of Cuba from 1948 until March 10, 1952.
- Mary Tarrero-Serrano was the second wife of Cuban President Carlos Prío Socarrás.
- Mary Tarrero-Serrano served as Cuban First Lady.
- On March 10, 1952, Fulgencio Batista led a military coup that deposed Carlos Prío Socarrás three months before new elections were to be held.
- After the 1952 coup, Fulgencio Batista ruled Cuba as a U.S.-backed dictator from 1952 to 1959.
- Fulgencio Batista was overthrown during the Cuban Revolution.
- Osvaldo Farrés received help and inspiration for the lyrics of Quizás, Quizás, Quizás from Cuban First Lady Mary Tarrero-Serrano.
- Fulgencio Batista died on August 6, 1973.
- Carlos Prío Socarrás died on April 5, 1977.
